txt_scheme_creator_contract.meaning: empty value means not encrypted / not creator locked in the user-verified software display
txt_scheme_creator_contract.delivery_gate: If encryption/lock is not explicitly requested, every delivered scheme TXT must contain SchemeCreator= with an empty value. Any non-empty value fails the package.

integer_multiplier_contract.scope: ordinary/straight betting plans in delivered TXT
integer_multiplier_contract.applies_when: 倍投类型=0 or ordinary straight-line multiplier fields are present
integer_multiplier_contract.allowed_pattern: positive integers separated by commas only
integer_multiplier_contract.delivery_gate: For ordinary straight-line betting, 投倍/倍投计划 and 投倍/倍投方案 must be integer sequences such as 1,1,2,3. Any decimal point fails the package.

fixed_pick_content_contract.scope: delivered 固定取码 TXT files
fixed_pick_content_contract.grammar: 位置范围|开出号码段|投注内容
fixed_pick_content_contract.problem_to_prevent: Do not mechanically write every open-number segment as 0-0; it creates a fake no-design package.
fixed_pick_content_contract.recommended_design: Use explainable low/mid/high open-number segment roles such as 0-2, 3-5, 6-9, 0-3, 4-8, 7-9. Each segment must have a role in the evidence record.

public_ppt_contract.audience: ordinary lottery players watching a video
public_ppt_contract.purpose: teach an artificial betting thought process, not explain how the private automation package was generated
required_story_questions: 倍投只是资金管理不是提高命中
连续不中如何停止或减压
